Main.dc.html.title: A · Smithy match, beside the weapons

s1.text:
What changed from v1 (from the Carolina Dog breed standard and dog-anatomy drawing guides):

• Muzzle tapers to a point, about as long as the skull.
• Ears are near-equilateral triangles set on top of the head, pointing a little forward. One is turned, like a real dingo listening.
• Almond eye set obliquely, with a brow.
• Straight back with a waist; brisket down to the elbow.
• Forelegs: shoulder → elbow → straight forearm → pastern → small compact paw.
• Hind legs: hip → stifle (forward) → hock (back) → rear pastern.
• Fish-hook tail carried at about 45°, paler underneath.
• Ginger with pale buff on muzzle, throat, chest and belly.

s2.text:
A and B use the exact Smithy recipe: hard split shading, one highlight strip, dark 3.2px outline, same oak/bronze warmth. The weapons on A are real ones pulled from the game.

C keeps the scratchy ink gothic you liked. B is the middle road: Smithy shading with a scratchy, hatched line, so the kinematic creatures can be drawn the same way.

The generator board has Tweaks for style and proportions.
